conclusion: Label instability is present in NQ/RTH/30min -- 17.4 percent of in-sample windows carry a state-mean gap below 0.25 against 6.9 percent in the holdout -- but removing those windows moves the in-sample rate by only 0.67 pp and the holdout by -0.04 pp, about 3 percent of a 21.95 pp inversion.
